findings.passage: How many more bullet casings and bodies must fall before legislators in our nation’s capital muster the courage to stop people from dying from weapons in our streets? It is beyond time to act,
findings.note: Joint statement from six King County Council members including him, after a mass shooting in Texas, reported by a local news outlet (wire story). Calls on Congress to act on gun deaths. Date approximate (shortly after the Texas shooting).
